definitions.s: (logp_state - logp_W0) / (logp_do-nothing - logp_W0), mean next-token log-probability on 64 held-out lowercase rows
definitions.check ratio: the Pile harness's PGD KL (calc_multibatch_pgd_masked_recon_loss, one random start, seed 0, 20 steps of 0.1, 256 val rows) over C1's W0 at seed 0; the stochastic ratio likewise
definitions.verdict: faith_score.verdict against C1's floors f: pass at or under 1.5 / (1 + f), fail at or over 1.5 (1 + f)
definitions.solution: s >= 0.9 and verdict 'pass' on the check and stochastic ratios
definitions.train KL: mean teacher KL over the 50 training steps ending at the read
